hooks.command: cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha hooks pre-command --command '{}' --validate-safety true --prepare-resources true --predict-outcome true --check-patterns true --batch true --cache true
cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "command/pre/$(date +%s)" --value '{}' --namespace "commands" --batch true
cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha neural predict --model "error_preventer" --input '{}' --block-if-risky true --cache true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha hooks pre-edit --file '{}' --auto-assign-agents true --load-context true --analyze-impact true --batch true --cache true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "edit/pre/{}" --value "$CLAUDE_OPERATION_CONTEXT" --namespace "edits" --batch true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha neural optimize --operation "file-edit" --target '{}' --suggest-improvements true --cache true
npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "todos/$(date +%s)" --value "$CLAUDE_TODOS" --namespace "tasks" --batch true
npx archon-os@alpha neural predict --model "task_predictor" --input "$CLAUDE_TODOS" --optimize-order true --cache true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha hooks post-command --command '{}' --track-metrics true --store-results true --analyze-performance true --batch true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "command/post/$(date +%s)" --value '{"command": "{}", "result": "$CLAUDE_RESULT", "duration": $CLAUDE_DURATION}' --namespace "commands" --batch true
npx archon-os@alpha neural train --model "performance_optimizer" --data '{"operation": "bash", "duration": $CLAUDE_DURATION, "success": $CLAUDE_SUCCESS}' --batch true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha hooks post-edit --file '{}' --format true --update-memory true --train-neural true --analyze-quality true

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "edit/post/{}" --value '{"changes": $CLAUDE_CHANGES, "quality_score": $CLAUDE_QUALITY_SCORE}' --namespace "edits" --batch true
npx archon-os@alpha neural train --model "task_predictor" --data '{"file_type": "$CLAUDE_FILE_TYPE", "operation": "$CLAUDE_OPERATION", "success": true}' --batch true
test $CLAUDE_CHECKPOINT_DUE = true && git add -A && git commit -m "🔄 Checkpoint: $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE edited" || true
npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "task/complete/$CLAUDE_TASK_ID" --value '{"task": "$CLAUDE_TASK", "agent": "$CLAUDE_AGENT", "result": "$CLAUDE_RESULT"}' --namespace "tasks"
npx archon-os@alpha neural train --model "task_predictor" --data '{"task_type": "$CLAUDE_TASK_TYPE", "agent_type": "$CLAUDE_AGENT_TYPE", "performance": $CLAUDE_PERFORMANCE}'

/bin/bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CUSTOM=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".custom_instructions // \"\""); echo "🔄 PreCompact Guidance:"; echo "📋 IMPORTANT: Review CLAUDE.md in project root for:"; echo "   • 54 available agents and concurrent usage patterns"; echo "   • Swarm coordination strategies (hierarchical, mesh, adaptive)"; echo "   • SPARC methodology workflows with batchtools optimization"; echo "   • Critical concurrent execution rules (GOLDEN RULE: 1 MESSAGE = ALL OPERATIONS)"; if [ -n "$CUSTOM" ]; then echo "🎯 Custom compact instructions: $CUSTOM"; fi; echo "✅ Ready for compact operation"'

/bin/bash -c 'echo "🔄 Auto-Compact Guidance (Context Window Full):"; echo "📋 CRITICAL: Before compacting, ensure you understand:"; echo "   • All 54 agents available in .claude/agents/ directory"; echo "   • Concurrent execution patterns from CLAUDE.md"; echo "   • Batchtools optimization for 300% performance gains"; echo "   • Swarm coordination strategies for complex tasks"; echo "⚡ Apply GOLDEN RULE: Always batch operations in single messages"; echo "✅ Auto-compact proceeding with full agent context"'
npx archon-os@alpha hooks session-end --generate-summary true --persist-state true --export-metrics true --backup-memory true --optimize-models true
npx archon-os@alpha memory backup --namespace "all" --destination ".claude/memory-backup-$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID.json"
npx archon-os@alpha neural train --model "all" --data "session" --comprehensive true
git add .claude/memory-backup-*.json && git commit -m "🧠 Session memory backup: $CLAUDE_SESSION_ID" || true
npx archon-os@alpha github create-gist --name "session-learnings-$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID" --content "$CLAUDE_SESSION_LEARNINGS" --private true || true
npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "prompt/$(date +%s)" --value "$CLAUDE_PROMPT" --namespace "prompts"
npx archon-os@alpha neural analyze --prompt "$CLAUDE_PROMPT" --suggest-approach true --predict-complexity true
npx archon-os@alpha checkpoint create --message "Auto-checkpoint: $CLAUDE_OPERATIONS_COUNT operations" --include-memory true
git add -A && git commit -m "🔄 Auto-checkpoint: $(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" || true
npx archon-os@alpha memory sync --remote true --compress true
npx archon-os@alpha memory store --key "error/$CLAUDE_ERROR_ID" --value '{"error": "$CLAUDE_ERROR", "context": "$CLAUDE_ERROR_CONTEXT"}' --namespace "errors"
npx archon-os@alpha neural train --model "error_preventer" --data '{"error_type": "$CLAUDE_ERROR_TYPE", "operation": "$CLAUDE_OPERATION", "prevent": true}'
npx archon-os@alpha analysis error-pattern --error "$CLAUDE_ERROR" --suggest-fix true --store-pattern true
infisical run --projectId="8374cea9-e5e8-4050-bda4-b91f25ab30ef" --env="dev" --path="/shared" -- claude mcp start
